user.title: HomeKit Room Sync
user.description:
Select the Home Assistant Areas that should each get a dedicated HomeKit Bridge. After setup, pair every bridge once in the Apple Home app and assign it to the matching room.

Scenes and scripts are available under Domains but off by default — HomeKit can only show them as switches.
